units.source_text: ……车厢的门扉突然打开了，公鸭嗓的小贩胸前挂着一个大篮子出现了。

en.t: ...The door of the train car suddenly opened, and a hoarse-voiced vendor appeared with a large basket hanging from his chest.

units.source_text: 我忽然觉得肚子饿，买了一盆盛满像是用海藻做的绿色面条吃了。

en.t: I suddenly felt hungry, so I bought and ate a bowl full of green noodles that looked as if they were made from seaweed.

units.source_text: 雾散了，天空依然是一片阴沉沉。

en.t: The mist had cleared, but the sky was still completely overcast.

units.source_text: 丹波山脊的贫瘠土地上，开始望见种植桔树的户户造纸人家。

en.t: On the barren land along the ridges of Tanba, houses of paper makers with orange trees planted around them began to come into view.
